claims.claim_text: 把 JavaScript bundle 體積削減 33%
claims.evidence: After rolling out Rollup to all Dropbox users, we found that this project reduced our JavaScript bundle sizes by 33%

claims.claim_text: LinkedIn 打造了新一代日誌儲存基礎設施 Northguard 與 Xinfra
claims.evidence: Northguard is a log storage system with a focus on scalability and operability. / Xinfra ... is a virtualized Pub/Sub layer supporting both Northguard and Kafka.

claims.claim_text: 訴求是可擴展性與可維運性；上層再疊一層叫 Xinfra 的虛擬化 Pub/Sub，同時支援 Northguard 與既有的 Kafka
claims.evidence: Northguard is a log storage system with a focus on scalability and operability. / Xinfra (pronounced as ZIN-frah) is a virtualized Pub/Sub layer supporting both Northguard and Kafka.
claims.note: Original lede claimed 'affordable storage cost and query latency' which the source did not support (verdict unverifiable, action correct). Parent rewrote the sentence to the source's actual framing (scalability/operability; Xinfra as virtualized Pub/Sub over Northguard+Kafka) — now verified.

claims.claim_text: 整理出一套讓分區策略「自己會長大」的設計原則，減少事後人工救火的頻率
claims.evidence: Partition by the primary key, not by `created_at`, and let a background service manage boundaries based on observed growth.

claims.claim_text: 一篇新論文用 20 種任務情境測試
提出一種會追蹤跨 PR 累積可疑訊號的監控器，把最容易被騙過的偵測率從 93% 壓到 47%
claims.evidence: a stateful link-tracker monitor that tracks suspicious buildup across PRs ... reduces gradual-attack evasion from 93% under the weakest standard diff monitor to 47%

claims.claim_text: 拉高推理力度（reasoning effort）比給它更多工具存取權更能提升可靠度
claims.evidence: Raising reasoning effort from High to xHigh lifted first try perfect runs from 28 percent to 89 percent ... The testing tool raised cost by 42 to 68 percent without improving functional score or reliability

claims.claim_text: OpenAI 要在近 9 億用戶規模上做到這件事
claims.evidence: OpenAI runs voice AI for 900 million users a week
claims.note: Source states 900 million weekly; lede's '近 9 億' slightly understates (deflation, not an error).

claims.claim_text: Kani 把 Rust 的 MIR 編譯進 CBMC 的位元精確驗證引擎...已經在正式 CI 跑出超過 1.6 萬個驗證任務，並揪出六個先前沒人發現的 bug
claims.evidence: Kani compiles proof harnesses from Rust's MIR into CBMC's bit-precise verification engine ... over 16,000 harnesses verified per code change ... six previously unknown bugs

claims.claim_text: 論文宣稱端到端吞吐量最多可再往上推 75%（相對未點名的先前工作，是個上限數字）
claims.evidence: FlintKV can achieve up to a 75% improvement in end-to-end throughput over prior work
claims.note: Original lede/title dropped the source's 'up to' qualifier, presenting 75% as a flat achieved gain (verdict unverifiable / hedge_delta inflated, action correct). Parent rewrote title to '最多多出 75%' and lede to '論文宣稱...最多可再往上推 75%（...是個上限數字）', restoring the hedge — now verified.

claims.claim_text: 目前已經通過 PHP 官方測試套件 17% 的案例，還能實際渲染一個真實的 WordPress 網站
claims.evidence: 3,844 of 22,037 — 17.4% of the entire upstream PHP test suite / The front page renders — real theme, real posts, real permalinks

claims.claim_text: 一個小型審查模型（Gemma 4 e4b）檢查含有 11 個後門的 Python 專案，抓漏率從無限制的 54.5% 提升到加上存取限制與工具後的 90.9%
claims.evidence: Recall rises from 54.5% (unconstrained, no tools) to 90.9% (constrained substrate plus a ~200-LoC docs CLI) ... Gemma 4 e4b ... 11 inserted backdoors
claims.note: Model name, backdoor count, and recall numbers all confirmed verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 一樣可以直接套用在 coding agent 身上，而且比近期流行的 agentic scaffolding 更省 token
claims.evidence: the same methods used for decades to manage large human engineering teams ... transfer directly to coding agents, and are cheaper (in token) than recent agentic scaffolding
